annotation.authors_or_issuer: 文部科学省 (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
key_provisions_or_claims: Appendix 1 sets facility and equipment standards (floor areas, equipment items) per subject group for industrial education subsidies.
Appendix 2 lists subjects belonging to each subject group.
Appendix 3 sets standard credit ranges per subject group.
The Minister may allow exceptions where enrolment is very small or large or local industry conditions warrant.
Subsidy rules apply from the fiscal year specified in each amendment.
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance (1976, as amended to 2020) implementing the Industrial Education Promotion Act. It sets detailed facility, equipment and credit standards for vocational subject groups (information, agriculture, engineering, fisheries, nursing, etc.) used for national subsidies. Not related to AI or robotics.
